io.github.franca-protocol:franca-spring-boot 0.18.0 发布, The platform assembler — the registration jar Spring Boot hosts add to
        get the full stack auto-configured. Wires the pure modules' constructors
        into conditional beans:
        - Auto-registers ApplicationAdapter beans by endpoint path
        - Auto-registers Driver beans
        - Wires the core pipeline with the default TransportSink (RoutingExecutor)
        - Exposes WebFlux endpoints that delegate to the Franca pipeline
        - Uses @ConditionalOnBean so every piece is optional and overrideable

        Assembly only: no business logic lives here (PTC and file storage moved
        to the pure modules). Extension registration jars (MCP tools, FC sandbox)
        sit beside it under franca-spring.

items.title:
io.github.franca-protocol:franca-ir 0.18.0 发布, Intermediate Representation definitions for both transport and application
        layers, plus the SPI surfaces that extensions implement against the IR,
        the pure-function mapper between the two IRs (ir.mapper, relocated
        from the removed franca-mapper module), and the pipeline
        itself (ir.pipeline / ir.route, relocated from the dissolved
        franca-core module — the narrow waist has exactly one home
        now, and everything the pipeline operates on already lived here).
        Key types: TransportFrame, TransportEvent, ApplicationFrame,
        ApplicationEvent, InputItem, ContentBlock, ApplicationTransportMapper,
        FrancaPipeline, TransportSink, PassExecutor, RouteRegistry,
        RoutingExecutor, HookRegistry.

        This is the single dependency an extension (a dialect adapter or a backend
        driver) needs: it carries the IR data records and the two SPI surfaces
        relocated out of the removed adapter-api / driver-api modules:
        - ir.adapter.ApplicationAdapter, ProtocolRequestException — dialect SPI
        - ir.driver.Driver, DriverInstance, HealthCheck, HealthStatus,
          DriverAddresses, DriverErrors — backend driver SPI

        Dependency direction: nothing below this module — the IR depends on no
        other franca module, and every module above it (hosted,
        adapters, drivers, tools, Spring) depends on this one. The pipeline
        reaches the hosted-tool execution layer only through the
        ir.pipeline.PassExecutor seam, which that layer implements.

        Both SPI surfaces and the pipeline declare Flux/Mono return types, so
        this module carries a compile-scope reactor-core dependency. The IR
        data records themselves stay reactor-free; reactor-core is pulled in
        only for the SPI method signatures and the pipeline.

io.github.franca-protocol:franca-thinking-retrieval 0.18.0 发布, The thinking family's one implementation of the ThinkingPhase
        SPI: the deep-research RetrievalPhase, plus the two-phase
        machinery (TwoPhaseThinkingExecutor) it builds on. A thinking
        key activates a retrieval pass that searches and crawls through
        the hosted web tools declared for it, streams its narration as
        the response's reasoning events, and injects its consolidated
        findings as a trailing conversation pair the answering pass
        cites; the machinery keeps the original request byte-identical
        across both passes (a KV-cache shared prefix) and exposes the
        phase-1 tools posture and the injection wording as protected
        seams. Pure implementation only — bean registration lives in
        the franca-spring-thinking-retrieval registration jar.

        repository modules, which implement HostedToolRepository (from
        franca-hosted) and discover callable tools from an
        external backend (the MCP module health-checks configured MCP
        endpoints via tools/list; the FC module resolves tool declarations
        from Function Compute functions on demand with a TTL cache), and
        local tool modules, which implement the platform's own built-in
        hosted-tool handlers executed in-process (the local module ships
        the registration site). Discovery, declaration, and handler
        implementations live here; the execution engine stays with the
        hosted-tool pipeline.

items.title:
io.github.franca-protocol:franca-hosted 0.18.0 发布, Hosted-tool execution layer, extracted from
        core so the pipeline module stays a pure through-pipe. Contains:
        - The hosted-tool SPI (HostedToolHandler, HostedToolRepository
          with the getOrder() precedence contract, HostedToolHandlerFactory,
          HostedToolResolution, OrchestratableTool)
        - The multi-pass hosted execution loop (HostedToolExecutor,
          pass lifecycle policies, output augmenter)

        Engine and SPI only: no repository implementation and no tool lives
        here. The local registration site (LocalHostedToolRepository) ships
        in franca-tools-local; the MCP repository in
        franca-tools-mcp; the FC function-library repository in
        franca-tools-alibaba-fc. Programmatic Tool Calling is owned by
        the orchestration entry resolved from a repository — there is no
        orchestration provider axis in this module.

        Depends on IR (typed requests/events, mapper) — but NOT on the
        pipeline, any adapter or driver, any tool module, or Spring. The
        pipeline consumes this module through one optional collaborator
        (HostedToolExecutor); a deployment that never declares a hosted
        tool never runs any of this code.
